integrity: The all-d statement is proved analytically. A packaged exact-arithmetic checker only corroborates the explicit four-dimensional witness and endpoint algebra. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the rank-one all-ones TCP core and the \(a=1\) endpoint of the cited DOC family; it does not classify general TCP triples or settle the PPT-squared conjecture.
title: Rank-one TCP cores detect toroidal correlations exactly
